# DT — Desktop capture and input

- Owner: `ticonnect-desktop`
- Stage: 11
- Layer: `services`
- Component graph: [generated/components/dt.md](generated/components/dt.md)

## Purpose

Own portal consent, PipeWire capture, capture backpressure, backend detection, and input injection through libei or XTEST.

## Boundary

Desktop library. No storage, D-Bus, or policy. Remote desktop orchestrates consent and sessions.

## Owned state

- portal session
- EIS file descriptor
- capture stream

## Invariants

- `INV-LIMIT-1` — Every queue, buffer, and frame decoder is bounded or declares its drop policy. Test: planned: design review plus fuzz tests
- `INV-RD-1` — Remote desktop requires per-session consent, a visible indicator, and a working kill switch. Test: planned: crates/daemon/tests/remote.rs
- `INV-SEC-1` — No secret, key, message body, or keystroke is logged by default. Test: planned: logging redaction tests
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check
- `INV-TRUST-1` — No non-pairing feature is reachable before trust is established. Test: planned: crates/net/tests/unpaired_rejected.rs

## Failure semantics

- no capture before consent
- drop frames under backpressure
- validate input bounds
- release devices on teardown

- portal capability matrix
